about: The release's copies of the records had vendor names removed and this machine's paths pointed into the release, which changed the SHA-256 fingerprints some records carry. Each fingerprint below was recomputed for the release copy only when it matched in the working repository and the release copy is exactly that record with the same text rewrite; every other record was left as it was.

changes.basis: Release-only edit checked (Oct 24, 2026): mimo_bridge/env.py BridgeEnv.__init__ re-roots its run_dir with repo_paths.localize before writing the scene files (a saved world names D:/UEMA_scratch/...; MuJoCo's C code opens those files). A run_dir that is not a recorded folder is unchanged. The rest of the mapped code is the development repository's at 9916126d1 with a copyright line added; the entry's description stands.

Release-only edit checked (Oct 24, 2026): mimo_bridge/__init__.py installs repo_paths, which reads the paths recorded on the development machine from the checkout; no training computation changed.
